# @game-studio/bindings

The Bindings package allows you to bind the values of your data stored in your models to values and functions in your classes

## Usage

#### To start, simply extend your model to {BindingModel} from the bindings package.
    ```ts
    // import from package
    import { BindingModel } from '@arcade-client/bindings';

    //extend to { BindingModel} 
    class GameModel extends BindingModel {
    }
    ```

#### Add your value to your model
    ```ts
    // updates all binds when value is changed
    @bind() public stake:number = 5; 

    // does not update when value is changed. 
    // use YOUR_MODEL.invalidate(() => this.stake); to update all bindings
    @bindPassive() public stake:number = 5; 


    // for custom checks before auto updating bindings , you will need to make 
    // a manual local property (using an underscore) and add your own 
    // setter and getter like the following. 
    private _stake: number = 5;
    public set stake(val: number) {
        if (val !== this.stake) {
            this._stake = val;
            this.invalidate(() => this.stake);
        }
    }
    public get stake(): number {
        return (this._stake);
    }
    ```

#### Setting up in a class to listen and react 
```ts
{

    // Bind from the target model.
    // The 1st param takes your reference of scope (this). : any
    // The 2nd param takes your reference of the model value.  : () => modelValue
    // The 3rd param takes the class function that will update.  : () => classFunction
    // An Optional 4th param for updating and getting the model value at start up) : boolean

    GameModel.bindToValue(this, () => GameModel.example,  () => onExampleUpdate$);

    private onExampleUpdate$(value: string) {
        console.log( 'example in GameModel has been updated' , value )
    }

}
```

## Development

### Testing

```
npm run test
```
```
npm run test:continuous
```

Testing is ran using Karma and will execute all `**/*.spec.ts` files within the `tests` folder.

The `:continuous` flag is useful while developing because it will watch for changes in the source code and tests and execute the suite accordingly.

#### Coverage

Test coverage is generated and available under `reports/coverage` once a test run has completed.

### Linting

```
npm run lint
```

Runs `eslint` and outputs any errors.

### Building and Documentation

```
npm run build
```

This will clean the distribution folder, build the project and generate the documentation.

### Publishing

This package should not be published manually. Publishing is handled by the parent [game-studio](https://github.com/tombolaltd/game-studio) using lerna.

**Note:** it's worth noting that the private registry the package is published to is defined in the `package.json` file.

### TypeScript

#### tsconfig.json

This package is built in TypeScript and the options are controlled by `tsconfig.json` for use in the IDE.
